3 Harbour Terrace, East Hill, Cobh, Co. Cork

Set in an elevated position on the highly sought-after East Hill, No. 3 Harbour Terrace is a charming four-bedroom end-of-terrace residence enjoying uninterrupted panoramic views across Cork Harbour. Combining generous accommodation, original character and exceptional versatility, this unique home is within easy walking distance of everything Cobh has to offer.

Extending to approximately 193 sq.m. (2,082 sq.ft.) over five levels, the property comprises a four-storey main residence together with a ground floor unit access from both the rear and front, offering excellent flexibility for extended family, guest accommodation and home office. 
The main house opens into a welcoming entrance hallway leading to a bright kitchen/dining room. The first floor comprises a spacious living room with an open fireplace overlooking the harbour, along with a double bedroom. The second floor offers the main bedroom, a further bedroom and a Jack-and-Jill bathroom. The attic is an open space. 

The ground floor unit has its own private entrance while also benefiting from access to the rear garden. 

The property retains many original features while benefiting from oil-fired central heating and double-glazed windows throughout. It also benefits from two separate electricity supplies, with independent MPRNs serving the main residence and the lower ground floor apartment, offering additional flexibility. To the rear is a private garden, while the elevated front aspect enjoys exceptional, uninterrupted views across Cork Harbour.
Ideally located on East Hill, the property is within walking distance of local primary and secondary schools, shops, cafés and everyday amenities. Cobh town centre is approximately a 15-minute walk away, while the train station is around 20 minutes on foot, providing convenient access to Cork City.

Offering exceptional harbour views, flexible accommodation and a prime location, No. 3 Harbour Terrace presents a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial home in one of Cobh’s most desirable settings.
